name: Short forecourt wing
summary: Shorten the current front-wing approach, with a lower roof and leisure rooms below the new footprint.
retained: Original house walls, main stair, four larger original bedrooms and main roof ridge.
main_changes: Shorter two-storey front wing with garage, gym and two bedroom suites
One side bedroom and a shallow rear living addition
Original loft workspace only; no occupied front loft
Cinema and wine bar beneath the new wing
Four outside parking spaces and rear pool
compromise: Basement excavation remains complex, and the new front wing remains the principal planning concern.
planning: Reduced front mass compared with the current proposal, but changing the established front building line still needs a persuasive design case.
status: Concept under development; dimensions from reconstructed model
